name: VERBASCUM THAPSUS
key_symptoms: Hoarse; voice deep, harsh; sounds like a trumpet; "basso profundo". Cough; worse at night. Asthma. Soreness in pharynx, cough during sleep.
Cramp-like pain in soles, right foot, and knee. Lower extremities feel heavy. Thumb feels numb. Neuralgic pain in left ankle. Stiffness and soreness of joints of lower extremities.
guiding_symptoms: Hoarse; voice deep, harsh; sounds like a trumpet; "basso profundo". Cough; worse at night. Asthma. Soreness in pharynx, cough during sleep.
Cramp-like pain in soles, right foot, and knee. Lower extremities feel heavy. Thumb feels numb. Neuralgic pain in left ankle. Stiffness and soreness of joints of lower extremities.

worse: change of temperature, talking, sneezing, biting hard (inferior dental nerve)

head_symptoms: Otalgia, with a sense of obstruction. Deafness. Dry, scaly condition of meatus (use locally).
respiratory_symptoms: Hoarse; voice deep, harsh; sounds like a trumpet; "basso profundo". Cough; worse at night. Asthma. Soreness in pharynx, cough during sleep.
gi_symptoms: Pain extends deep down, causing contraction of sphincter ani.
urinary_symptoms: Constant dribbling. Enuresis. Burning urination. Increase with pressure in bladder.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Cramp-like pain in soles, right foot, and knee. Lower extremities feel heavy. Thumb feels numb. Neuralgic pain in left ankle. Stiffness and soreness of joints of lower extremities.
